name: pg_partition_prune_issue_range_s
goal:
Pruning a RANGE-partitioned table with a default partition can omit the default when an IN list mixes values inside explicit ranges with values in the gaps outside them.

With explicit partitions `[0,10)` and `[10,20)` plus a default, `a IN (5,15)` must scan only the two explicit partitions; `a IN (20,21)` and `a IN (-1,20)` must scan only the default; and `a IS NOT NULL AND a IN (-1,5,15,20)` must scan all three. No partition capable of a match may be omitted, and no impossible partition should be retained. Other scalar-array pruning must remain unchanged.
